ai.widgetGuide:
A widget is data, never code: {id (a-z, 0-9, hyphen), name, description, size, background, elements}.
size: {w, h} in grid cells, w 2-12, h 2-16.
background: {kind:"card"}, {kind:"color",color} or {kind:"gradient",start,end,angle}.
Every element has id, kind, x, y, w, h in percent of the widget, and opacity from 0 to 1.
Paint is text, muted, accent, card or #rrggbb.
text: text, size (percent of the widget's height), bold, align (left, center, right), color (paint).
metric: source, range, size, bold, align, color.
chart: source (series), chart (bar, line), range, color.
progress: source, range, goal (number), style (ring, bar), color.
heatmap: nothing else.
shape: shape (rectangle, ellipse), fill (paint), radius.
source: reviews, ratings, studyTime, successRate, retention, activeDays, dueCards, currentStreak, longestStreak, dailyAverage.
series: timeline, ratingTimeline, answerButtons, deckActivity, forecast, cardStates, weekdays, hours.
range: dashboard, today, last7, last30, lastYear. Use dashboard to follow the dashboard's filter.
Example: {"id":"study-today","name":"Study time today","description":"","size":{"w":4,"h":4},"background":{"kind":"card"},"elements":[{"id":"e1","kind":"text","text":"Today","x":8,"y":10,"w":84,"h":24,"opacity":1,"size":16,"bold":true,"align":"left","color":"muted"},{"id":"e2","kind":"metric","source":"studyTime","range":"today","x":8,"y":40,"w":84,"h":50,"opacity":1,"size":34,"bold":true,"align":"left","color":"text"}]}

get_today.description: Today in the user's Anki calendar and the first review date. Call before working out dates.

get_statistic.description: Read a statistic. summary: reviews, ratings, study time in ms, success rate, retention, active days; categories: distinct cards as new, reviewed, relearned, failed; decks: count per deck; timeline: count per day, week or month; buttons: ratings per button; rhythm: count per weekday and hour; heatmap: count per day of a year, with streaks; due: cards ready now; forecast: cards coming due; states: cards per learning state; anki: Anki's statistics page by view: today, future-due, calendar, reviews, card-counts, intervals, stability, difficulty, retrievability, hours, buttons, added, true-retention. summary to rhythm need start and end (YYYY-MM-DD, both included). heatmap takes year (null is this year). deckId null means all decks. review: a card moved to a later day, once a day; rating: any button press. measure picks one for decks to heatmap.

find_cards.description: Find cards with Anki's search, for example deck:Spanish or a word on the card. Needs the person's permission, which the app asks for by itself.

get_card.description: One card's fields, tags, deck, state and recent reviews. Needs the person's permission.

get_dashboard.description: The widgets on the dashboard and where they sit.

get_goals.description: The person's study goals with today's progress, streak, minutes left and notices.

list_custom_widgets.description: The widgets the user made, in full.

get_settings.description: The appearance settings you may suggest changes to.

get_widget_format.description: How a widget is built. Call this before propose_widget.

open_page.description: Open a page of Statly for the person. highlight points at a setting on it: language, theme, autoUpdate, fullscreen.

ask_user.description: Ask the person something with 2 to 5 short options, shown as buttons. Use this instead of writing choices or a question with likely answers into your text.

propose_widget.description: Suggest a new custom widget, or a change to one by reusing its id. addToDashboard also places it.

propose_dashboard.description: Suggest a new dashboard: layout {widgets:[{id,type,x,y,w,h}]}, 12 columns. Types: review-summary, rating-summary, learned-cards, review-breakdown, study-time, success-rate, due-cards, deck-activity, deck-ratings, review-timeline, rating-timeline, answer-buttons, due-forecast, card-states, study-rhythm, rating-rhythm, review-heatmap, rating-heatmap, anki-today, anki-future-due, anki-calendar, anki-reviews, anki-card-counts, anki-intervals, anki-stability, anki-difficulty, anki-retrievability, anki-hours, anki-buttons, anki-added, anki-true-retention, or custom:<id>.

propose_goal.description: Suggest a study goal. The person checks it on the setup page and saves it there. goal: {id (null for a new one, or a goal's id to change it), name, archived:false, config:{kind:"exam", decks:[{id,name}] from list_decks, examDate YYYY-MM-DD, bufferDays 0-60, mode learned|reviewed, counts newAndDue|newOnly, studyWeekdays 0-6 with Monday 0, freeDates []}}.

propose_settings.description: Suggest settings: patch with theme, language, counterColorsEnabled, counterColors, wallpaper, deckHeatmap, brandAnimation. theme: system, light, dark, frutiger-aero. language: auto, en, de.
